result.title: Bridging Low-Level Image Fusion and High-Level Semantic Understanding
result.summary: Remote sensing image fusion and semantic interpretation are usually optimized separately, so reconstruction quality need not preserve downstream retrieval utility. We propose LANCE, which uses structured language as an explicit, indexable semantic state. A frozen vision-language model maps the input to a closed-vocabulary text record; a language-conditioned generator fuses the imagery; and a dense verifier with a differentiable continuous summarizer re-describes the output. Text-text consistency and anti-collapse contrastive text-mask losses with negative queries close the loop without dense annotations or VLM fine-tuning. A variational EM formulation yields a per-step contraction result under regularity assumptions, distinguishing semantic faithfulness from verifier overfitting. Across seven test sets on GF2, QuickBird, WorldView-III, and WorldView-II, LANCE improves reduced-scale reference metrics by up to 11.7% (median 2.1%) over the strongest learning baseline. Independent evaluation using a held-out VLM and a supervised aerial detector yields gains of +6.4 mAP and +0.072 open-vocabulary F1 over the closest competitor. Text perturbations, cross-verifier transfer, and pseudo-RGB ablations examine the mechanisms underlying these gains. The framework connects image fusion to verifiable semantic representations for multimodal retrieval and knowledge management.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LANCE，在遥感图像融合中用冻结 VLM 生成封闭词表的显式文本语义状态，配合语言条件生成器与稠密验证器闭环训练，并区分语义忠实与验证器过拟合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其反坍缩对比损失和「语义忠实 vs 验证器过拟合」的判别可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真被使用、增益是否来自验证器过拟合；但任务属图像融合与检索，并非推理期状态生成，仅作方法线索。
